build_visual_cnn: build a VisualCNN module that takes RGB and depth observations and produces a feature embedding
create_conv_output_dim: create a function that calculates convolutional layer output dimensions from input size, stride, padding, and kernel size
test_layer_init: test the layer_init function that applies Kaiming normal initialization to Conv2d and Linear layers
run_visual_cnn_forward: run the VisualCNN forward pass to encode RGB and depth observation tensors into a fixed-size embedding
review_visual_cnn_is_blind: review the VisualCNN is_blind property that returns true when no RGB or depth input channels are available
